label: preparing
what: Likely a private bread-and-grain supply arrangement, possibly tied to reported grain shortage / hay-bale sourcing. The baker received wheat from freight and bread was delivered to the innkeeper; the innkeeper sought spare wheat or hay. Neighbour knows about some of these dealings and relayed them, but evidence of knowingly assisting is weak. No solid evidence of a secret bridge or port project; that appears to be rumor. Builder's hall-light inspection is an openly disclosed official appointment, not an undisclosed joint preparation.
